observations: Photo shows a single car headlight assembly (front lamp) with a clear lens and amber turn-signal section.
No visible vehicle make/model, part number, or label on the headlight in the photo.
No other parts (engine/suspension/body panels) are shown.

claims.claim: Body, engine n suspension for all model of honda, acura n toyota cars n suvs
claims.evidence: Only one headlight is visible in photo 0; no body/engine/suspension parts are shown, and no Honda/Acura/Toyota identification is readable.

risks.risk: The item being sold may not be body/engine/suspension at all; the photo appears to be only a headlight assembly.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the exact items included in the sale (all parts) laid out, not just one headlight.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a single used headlight only (worst case: not confirmed compatible).

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: headlight fitment depends on exact car model/year/trim and side (left/right).
risks.proof: Ask for the car details it fits (make/model/year) and whether it is left or right; also request a close-up of any part number sticker/marking on the housing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown fitment used headlight (worst case: may not fit).

risks.risk: Condition risk: lens clarity, internal moisture, cracks, and reflector damage are not fully verifiable from this single angle.
risks.proof: Request a photo of the lens from multiple angles plus a close-up of the reflector and any cracks; ask for a working test video showing both low/high beams.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working/unknown condition.

risks.risk: Missing accessories risk: bulbs, wiring harness, mounting brackets, and adjuster parts may be missing.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing everything included (bulbs, wiring, brackets) and whether it comes with the connector/plug.
risks.if_unproven: Price as headlight only (worst case: missing bulbs/wiring).

proof_requests: Confirm exactly what is included in the sale (list of parts) and send photos of each part.
Tell the exact car make/model/year and whether the headlight is left or right.
Send a close-up photo of any part number/marking on the headlight housing.
Send a working test video (low beam and high beam) and photos of the lens/reflector for cracks or moisture.
response.reason: The seller’s claim is about body/engine/suspension, but the only photo shows a single headlight with no readable compatibility details. Without proof of the exact item(s) and fitment/condition, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
